About Fatimo

Hi, I'm Fatimo Olasunkanmi, a Channel Manager and Digital Growth Strategist helping streamers, YouTubers, and content creators build stronger channels and grow engaged communities.

I specialize in Twitch and YouTube channel management, social media strategy, content planning, SEO, audience engagement, and channel optimization. My goal is to help creators not only reach more people but also turn viewers into loyal followers and active communities.

I take a strategy-first approach by understanding each creator's brand, audience, content, and goals before developing a growth plan that fits their needs.

Whether you're a growing streamer, an established YouTuber, or a creator building your personal brand, I'm here to help you improve your online presence, reach the right audience, and grow with purpose.

Friendly first

No jargon, no pressure — just honest advice about what will actually move your channel forward.

Built around you

Every plan is shaped by your niche, your goals, and where you are right now.

Full-service

From branding to SEO to editing, everything a growing channel needs, in one place.

Results-driven

Every service is tied to a clear outcome — more views, more subs, more revenue.

Services

Pick one service or bundle a few — everything is built around your channel's goals.

Twitch Marketing
A recurring marketing plan to grow your live viewership — raid strategy, cross-platform promotion, and community-building tactics tailored to your niche.
YouTube Promotion
Distribution and promotion support to push new uploads to the audiences most likely to watch, subscribe, and come back.
YouTube Monetisation
Set up and optimise every monetisation path available to your channel — ads, memberships, sponsorships — so growth actually pays.
YouTube Thumbnails
Custom thumbnail design built to stop the scroll and stay consistent with your channel's look, tested against what's working in your niche.
Twitch Branding
Full visual identity for your Twitch channel — panels, overlays, emotes direction, and a consistent look across every touchpoint.
YouTube Video Editing
End-to-end editing for retention — pacing, captions, sound design, and hooks built to keep viewers watching to the end.
YouTube SEO
Titles, descriptions, tags, and metadata strategy so your videos get discovered through search and suggested feeds, not just your existing subscribers.
Twitch Promotion
Ongoing promotion across social and community channels to build a consistent, engaged Twitch audience over time.
